original_role: Derive a parameter pointer from an already resolved VDMFRAME.
lease-compatible_shape: Yes, only as a byte offset inside the still-live parent frame lease.
package_disposition: Must not independently acquire or release; source-wide pointer-plane contract required.

original_role: End a temporary VDM alias lifetime.
lease-compatible_shape: Yes, if it resolves the exact active scoped lease and rejects an unknown pointer.
package_disposition: Must be paired with each acquisition across selected WOW32 sources; a callback-only override is prohibited.

original_role: Resolve a fixed-size guest object from a 32-bit VDM pointer.
lease-compatible_shape: Yes, with required byte count and an access-selected scoped lease.
package_disposition: Candidate for a same-named macro bridge after full nested-lifetime audit.

original_role: Commit a modified guest object before its original alias release.
lease-compatible_shape: Yes, by marking the exact active write lease for commit.
package_disposition: Commit must occur before FREEVDMPTR and cannot survive host_simulate or another async boundary.

original_role: Resolve an optional terminated guest string.

package_disposition: Requires separate bounded-string policy; not enabled by frame bridge.

original_role: Resolve an optional variable-sized guest object.
lease-compatible_shape: Partially; original call sites supply only the minimal initial extent.
package_disposition: Requires source-family audit before any selected source is enabled.

package_disposition: T335 S3 P1 establishes this smallest bridge; S3 P2 forbids making it a private callback-only macro override.
